# Mixed-source and alternate-locale fixture

Original synthetic fixtures for a bounded native semantic/inventory trial. Copy only
`targets/` to host projects. `gold/` is withheld and primary-agent authored, not an
independent human acceptance set. The two material units are a globally scoped seat
contradiction and missing reciprocal alternate annotation. Regional refund policies
and historical query versions are clean controls. Discovery must merge tracking
aliases across sources without losing locale/version identities; missing analytics
keeps completeness false. No actual fetch, indexing or visibility is implied.
